name: Auditing Algorithmic Fairness in EHR Mortality Models
description: A systematic audit of subgroup calibration and error-rate disparities across race, sex, and insurance status in widely deployed EHR mortality risk scores. We propose a reweighting-based mitigation that closes the largest disparities while preserving overall discrimination, evaluated on MIMIC-IV and a community hospital cohort.

name: Early Sepsis Prediction from ICU Time-Series
description: A recurrent + attention model that forecasts sepsis onset up to 6 hours ahead from streaming vitals and labs in the MIMIC-IV and eICU cohorts. The emphasis is on calibration and clinically actionable lead time rather than chasing raw AUROC, with an external-validation arm on a held-out hospital system.

name: Open LLMs for Clinical Note Summarization
description: Fine-tuning and evaluating open-weight LLMs (Llama and Mistral) for faithful discharge-summary generation from inpatient progress notes. Includes a hallucination-detection harness that grounds every generated claim against the source chart, plus a blinded clinician evaluation of factuality and utility.
